HPE Telco vTeMIP Access Module — Hewlett Packard Enterprise
Technologies: Java 17, Spring Boot 3.2, Microservices, REST APIs, Hibernate, Apache Kafka, SNMP4J, Salesforce, Jenkins, Git, SonarQube
Team Size: 10
Developed and maintained enterprise-grade, data-centric telecom management services using Java and Spring Boot.
Designed and implemented RESTful APIs consumed by various clients; utilized Swagger for endpoint simulation and testing.
Reduced system failure rates by 70% through robust unit and load testing.
Customized CI/CD pipelines via Jenkins for efficient build and deployment workflows.
Worked directly with clients to gather requirements and resolve technical dependencies.
TMS (Transportation Management Solution) — Nokia
Technologies: Java 11, Spring Boot, REST, Eureka, Microservices, MySQL, Docker, Kubernetes, Kafka, Jenkins, AWS
Team Size: 13
Built and customized fault and performance management modules using Spring Boot microservices for network health monitoring.
Developed SNMP Alarm Handler and simulated message flows using Kafka and REST APIs for end-to-end fault analysis.
Actively involved in full SDLC including requirements gathering, development, testing, and production support.
Automated deployments and environment configurations using Docker, Kubernetes, and Jenkins.
Created detailed technical documentation and participated in UAT and production rollouts.
CrossWorks Network Automation (NCA) — HCL Technologies
Technologies: Java 8, Spring Boot, J2EE, Netconf, NSO, YANG, YDK, Docker, Kubernetes, Python, Postgres, SQL Server
Team Size: 18
Developed automation solutions for router configuration management using Netconf and Cisco NSO within the CrossWorks framework.
Designed and implemented modular playbooks leveraging YANG/YDK for automated router tasks and configuration tracking.
Delivered complete backup and restore functionality for router configurations.
Built SQL queries and stored procedures to support backend data operations in PostgreSQL and SQL Server.
Contributed across all project phases—requirements, design, implementation, testing, and production support.
LendingStream 2.0 (Rebranding P&L) — Global Analytics – Banking & Insurance Domain
Technologies: Java, Spring Boot, Hibernate, MySQL, REST APIs, AWS
Team Size: 25
Led development of key card and payment modules in LendingStream 2.0, ensuring PCI DSS compliance and secure financial transactions.
Designed and deployed high-availability architecture using AWS EC2 and Elastic IPs for geo-failover support.
Implemented features such as eSign and SECCI pages to enhance customer loan onboarding experience.
Participated across the full SDLC in an Agile environment; recognized with promotion to Senior Software Engineer for outstanding contributions.
Line of Credit (LOC / LILOC) — Global Analytics – Insurance Domain
Technologies: Java, Spring Boot, Hibernate, MySQL, Python
Team Size: 9
Delivered new feature enhancements for a low-interest daily loan platform tailored to underbanked U.S. customers.
Designed and implemented core financial functionalities including Reclock and Charge-Off modules.
Supported financial audits by cleaning and stabilizing backend data using SQL and Python scripting.
Produced technical documentation during FD and TD phases, and provided production support to resolve real-time issues.
